The audio bridge of OpenAL, its streaming sources and the binding that a backend gives it.
Learn: [base-openal](/build/base-modules/openal/).

| Type | Kind | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`AlAudioBridge`](/reference/base-openal/alaudiobridge/) | class | The audio bridge of OpenAL, whose streaming sources call OpenAL through a binding. |
| [`AlAudioSource`](/reference/base-openal/alaudiosource/) | class | A source of OpenAL that streams the samples of a video through a queue of buffers. |
| [`AudioGain`](/reference/base-openal/audiogain/) | interface | A function that maps the gain and the audio group of a source to the volume sent to OpenAL. |
| [`IAlBinding`](/reference/base-openal/ialbinding/) | interface | The OpenAL calls that `AlAudioBridge` needs, implemented once per LWJGL version. |
